[[File:FH6 Nissan Silvia K's 1989.png|150px|left]]{{quote|The 1989 Nissan Silvia K's is the highest spec trim level of the S13, earning the 'K for King' variant. This Silvia has stood the test of time with cutting edge Multilink Rear Suspension and a Turbocharged 1.8-liter twin-cam engine producing 173 hp, granting an exquisite and stylish driving experience.|Challenge Description}}
